programs.name: Bachelor of Mathematics
programs.notes: Students planning on completing a fourth year of study in the Bachelor of Mathematics (Honours) (HMATH) are required to identify and transfer into their chosen major prior to the end of third year. It is recommended this plan change occurs at the end of the first year of the program to ensure that the requirements of the identified major are met in a timely manner. Requirements for majors build from the second year onwards, so students should seek advice from their Program Director regarding major choices. Students should carefully review the requirements of the work integrated learning (WIL) options. Students must complete Statistical Practice (STATX290) together with exactly one of the following pairs of courses: MATH3013 + MATH3900, OR MATH3902 + MATH3901, OR MATH3902 + MATHX315.

Discipline courses and electives can be taken in either semester subject to availability and prerequisite requirements being met.

programs.name: Bachelor of Mathematics (Honours)
programs.notes: Students in the Bachelor of Mathematics (Honours) program (HMATH) must achieve a GPA of 5.0 at the completion of 144 units of study (equivalent to 3 years full-time) to progress into an Honours project and coursework in fourth year. Exceptions may be considered by application through the relevant Honours Coordinator, with approval determined by the Dean Academic. Students who do not meet this requirement must transfer into the three-year Bachelor of Mathematics program (BMATH). Students planning on completing a fourth year of study in the Bachelor of Mathematics (Honours) (HMATH) are required to identify and transfer into their chosen major prior to the end of third year. It is recommended this plan change occurs at the end of the first year of the program to ensure that the requirements of the identified major are met in a timely manner. Requirements for majors build from the second year onwards, so students should seek advice from their Program Director regarding major choices. Students should carefully review the requirements of the work integrated learning (WIL) options. Students must complete Statistical Practice (STATX290) together with exactly one of the following pairs of courses: MATH3013 + MATH3900, OR MATH3902 + MATH3901, OR MATH3902 + MATHX315. Discipline courses and electives can be taken in either semester subject to availability and prerequisite requirements being met.
